description: This file contains mock wrapper implementations for system calls in C++, including functions like system, popen, pclose, syslog, and readlink. It uses the singleton pattern via the Wraps class to delegate calls to an underlying implementation, likely for testing or hooking purposes.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A singleton class providing wrappers for system functions, delegating calls to an underlying implementation object.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract interface that defines the system functions which the Wraps class delegates to.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Delegates the system() call to underlying implementation.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Delegates the popen() call to underlying implementation.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Delegates the pclose() call to underlying implementation.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Delegates the syslog() call with va_list to underlying implementation.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Delegates variadic secure popen to underlying implementation.
